description: Required core timestamp profile and comparison artifacts. validation_cases apply to a core sent_at or a present question/approval deadline. schema_valid records only the time schema pattern and type check; valid also requires Gregorian calendar validation under core/timestamps.md. Validity here is not authentication or semantic admission. comparison_cases contain valid profile values and require exact value comparison independently of string spelling. cases are abstract adapter traces, not executed actor implementations. Unless stated otherwise, frames are first-seen, currently authenticated, canonically signed, correctly addressed, authorized and in established live scopes with applicable resource and reference checks satisfied; earlier failures and retained-copy handling retain their specified precedence. Ordinary refusal expectations assume a non-control message and authorized return route. O is the approval/question originator and owns the deadline. This artifact does not prescribe an implementation type, clock source, synchronization mechanism or real-time guarantee.

validation_cases.name: future century divisible by four hundred
century nineteen hundred is not leap
century twenty-one hundred is not leap

comparison_cases.name: absent fraction equals six zero digits
one digit equals two with trailing zero
one digit equals six after right padding
variable precision cannot use raw lexical order

cases.name: invalid calendar sent_at is refused before admission

steps.event: first-seen otherwise valid say S has sent_at 2030-02-30T12:00:00Z
expect: the time shape matches the payload schema but explicit Gregorian validation fails
classify S as malformed at structural checking and send the permitted ordinary refusal
do not acknowledge S, open a turn, or normalize the date to March

cases.name: an impossible approval deadline creates no pending request

steps.event: first-seen approval P has deadline 2100-02-29T12:00:00Z
expect: classify P as malformed during structural checking
do not acknowledge P, retain it as a pending approval, or perform timer arithmetic on the invalid value

cases.name: an impossible question deadline creates no pending question

steps.event: first-seen otherwise valid question Q targets an open turn and has deadline 2030-04-31T12:00:00Z
expect: classify Q as malformed during structural checking
do not acknowledge Q or create a pending question or timer
do not normalize the deadline into May

cases.name: excess precision is invalid even when discarded digits are zero

steps.event: first-seen approval P has deadline 2030-01-01T12:00:00.1234560Z
expect: classify P as malformed
do not shorten the signed value to six digits, round it, or admit it based on equivalent numeric value

cases.name: invalid decision timestamp cannot fall through a comparison

steps.event: pending valid approval P has deadline 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z; newly received decide D has sent_at 2030-01-01T12:60:00Z
expect: classify D as malformed at structural checking before decision consistency or owner-clock comparisons
do not turn an invalid parse or NaN into a false later-than result
D supplies no accepted decision

cases.name: invalid ack timestamp receives no core response

steps.event: recognizable first-seen ack A has sent_at 2030-02-30T12:00:00Z
expect: classify its timestamp as malformed if structural checking is reached
do not use A as confirmation
send no ack, refusal, or verification diagnostic in response to the control

cases.name: invalid reserved diagnostic timestamp has no submission effect

steps.event: recognizable first-seen reserved refusal D has the expected authenticated peer and unique original-route association but sent_at 2030-01-01T12:00:00.1234567Z
expect: reject the invalid diagnostic at structural checking
do not terminate the associated attempt series or alter a slot or disposition
send no core response to D

cases.name: unsupported version precedes timestamp validation

steps.event: otherwise authenticated and correctly addressed non-control frame has version 99 and sent_at 2030-02-30T12:00:00Z
expect: classify the supported-version failure as unsupported before checking the timestamp
send only the response permitted by the original binding and control rules
perform no admission or timer arithmetic

cases.name: invalid timestamp precedes unsupported content type

steps.event: otherwise valid first-seen question Q has deadline 2030-02-30T12:00:00Z and a structurally shaped content block of an unsupported type
expect: classify Q as malformed for its timestamp before the later content-type check
do not create question state or timer arithmetic

cases.name: earlier authentication failure keeps precedence

steps.event: first-seen non-control frame has an invalid signature and impossible sent_at 2030-02-30T12:00:00Z
expect: classify the verification failure as bad-signature before payload timestamp validation
a permitted response uses the restricted verification diagnostic path
no semantic request is admitted

cases.name: earlier addressing failure keeps precedence

steps.event: first-seen signed non-control frame passes earlier verification checks but is addressed elsewhere and has impossible sent_at 2030-02-30T12:00:00Z
expect: classify not-addressed-to-me before timestamp validation
the timestamp does not authorize response routing or semantic admission

cases.name: retired scope rejects before timestamp feedback

steps.event: a frame with impossible sent_at arrives on a retired provisioned conversation scope
expect: apply the existing generic binding rejection before retained-state or timestamp-specific feedback
do not create replacement context or reserve a message ID
do not send a core malformed refusal

cases.name: eligible exact retained copies keep their earlier disposition

steps.event: valid approval P with six-digit timestamps was authenticated and accepted while its credential was valid, and its exact signed bytes and disposition remain retained
expect: retain the established authentication fact and exact bytes

steps.event: the same exact signed P is retried within its live eligible scope after credential expiry and after P has closed
expect: apply P04 retained-copy handling with independently current feedback authorization
do not treat its past sent_at or deadline as a new malformed timestamp or a new pending request
do not repeat approval admission or reopen P

cases.name: eligible exact retained controls remain no-ops

steps.event: an exact retained ack with a valid six-digit sent_at is received again on its eligible active route after its credential expires
expect: preserve prior confirmation under retained-copy handling
send no core response
do not freshly expire the retained control based on its credential or timestamp age

cases.name: equivalent timestamp strings do not make identical signed retries

steps.event: accepted message M uses sent_at 2030-01-01T12:00:00.1Z and its exact signed bytes are retained
expect: its timestamp value equals the value denoted by 2030-01-01T12:00:00.100000Z

steps.event: a new signed frame reuses M's scoped ID but replaces sent_at with 2030-01-01T12:00:00.100000Z
expect: classify conflicting signed identity as malformed under existing reuse rules
do not normalize the frame into an exact retained copy
preserve the accepted original bytes and disposition

cases.name: decision sent_at equality can pass while the owner is still before expiry

steps.event: pending P has deadline 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z; valid authorized bound D has sent_at equal to that deadline; O processes D at 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123455Z on its own clock
expect: the sender-time consistency comparison passes because sent_at is no later than deadline
the independent owner-clock comparison is strictly before the deadline
accept the otherwise valid decision once and close P as decided
no global clock ordering or synchronization guarantee follows

cases.name: one microsecond later sent_at fails consistency before owner expiry

steps.event: pending P has deadline 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z; otherwise valid D has sent_at 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123457Z; O is still before the deadline
expect: refuse D as closed under the decision consistency rule
do not truncate either value to milliseconds or round away the one-microsecond difference
D supplies no accepted decision

cases.name: owner equality expires approval even if the callback has not run

steps.event: P remains pending with deadline 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z; D has an earlier valid sent_at; O processes it at exactly the deadline before its expiry callback runs
expect: expire P using the owner-clock comparison at decision processing
refuse D as closed and issue owner closure expired
the earlier sender time and delayed callback do not extend P

cases.name: owner later processing cannot use timely sent_at to reopen approval

expect: expire still-pending P and refuse D as closed
preserve the one-microsecond owner-clock distinction
do not infer acceptance from the sender timestamp

cases.name: question expiry uses the same exact owner boundary

steps.event: open question Q has deadline 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z; its originator processes a new answer at exactly that deadline
expect: expire Q on the originator clock and refuse the later new answer as closed
do not extend the question because its expiry callback has not run
do not round the deadline to milliseconds

cases.name: credential tolerance does not extend a payload deadline

steps.event: D passes current credential checks including the credential-specific NumericDate allowance; P's deadline has already been reached on O's clock
expect: refuse the new decision as closed
do not add the credential allowance or a Kerberos-style skew window to P's deadline
keep credential validity and decision expiry separate

cases.name: whole-second and millisecond producers remain conformant

steps.event: an application creates valid messages with whole-second or three-digit sent_at values and valid question deadlines with six fractional digits
expect: accept the permitted representations subject to the normal independent checks
the producer need not emit six digits or claim a microsecond-accurate clock
every receiver must nevertheless preserve the six-digit deadline

cases.name: application timestamp data keeps its own contract

steps.event: otherwise valid say S has a valid core sent_at and data containing a nine-digit sensor timestamp allowed by its selected application schema
expect: do not apply the core six-digit limit recursively to application data
validate application data under its selected contract
the sensor timestamp is not substituted for the core sent_at or deadline

cases.name: operation format annotations remain annotations

steps.event: an advertised operation schema uses format date-time for an application string and otherwise conforms to the embedded-schema profile
expect: core timestamp validation does not turn the operation format annotation into a core assertion
application semantics remain the application owner's responsibility

cases.name: a valid timestamp alone supplies no freshness or processing order

steps.event: a currently authenticated first-seen otherwise admissible message has a valid old sent_at and satisfies retained-state and continuity requirements
expect: do not reject it solely for exceeding an invented payload timestamp age
sent_at does not order processing, reopen state, or authorize a retry
apply any separately established application or deployment restrictions under their own contract

cases.name: deadline before sent_at is not a general structural error

steps.event: an otherwise valid question or approval has a valid deadline earlier than its own valid sent_at
expect: the timestamps are structurally valid; no general deadline >= sent_at rule is inferred
apply the existing originator-owned lifecycle and any already-expired behavior
a decision's separate sent_at <= approval deadline consistency rule still applies

cases.name: microsecond representation does not promise execution by a deadline

steps.event: a deployment accepts a valid approval decision before its microsecond deadline but the application action has not executed
expect: permission has been accepted but action completion is not established
the application contract governs effect timing
clock accuracy, scheduling latency, transport latency and synchronization remain deployment responsibilities

cases.name: finer internal clocks need not be reduced to wire resolution

steps.event: P deadline is 2030-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z and O's internal clock reports 2030-01-01T12:00:00.1234559Z during processing
expect: the internal reading is before the deadline
the six-digit payload limit does not require rounding an internal clock reading across the boundary
this internal reading is not a permitted core wire timestamp with seven fractional digits
